title: Open-source prior art becomes a required, registry-backed input to significant design decisions
summary: Operator directive 2026-09-29. Implemented by extending existing primitives: a PA registry added to the meta-improvement registry index (projects/personal-agent-os/research/prior-art/, schema prior-art-entry-v1), a deterministic tool (orchestrate prior-art lookup/queries/stale/refresh/validate), validation in agent-os validate (entries, no blended score, ADOPT needs linked evidence; warning when a DEC from DEC-0008 on lacks prior_art), a proportional check in ENTRYPOINT step 2, constitution section 15, canonical policy rule 12 and the generated AGENTS/CLAUDE adapters, a prior_art block in policy/orchestrator-os.policy.json, and an optional prior-art line in the generated next prompt (only when the next action names a problem). Protected paths changed under the operator's standing grant because this next action required them: policy/orchestrator-os.policy.json, policy/CANONICAL_AGENT_POLICY.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md. No check was weakened.

prior_art.checked: existing Agent OS registries (research registry-index, external-corpora registry, improvement records)
prior_art.found: no existing technology-evaluation registry; external-corpora.json covers datasets only
prior_art.reused: registry-index prefix convention, evidence-record links, validate pipeline, continuation generator
prior_art.why_custom: the registry is Agent OS state; no external tool should own it
